status.description: done: every Done-when item is met. partial: some are. blocked: you stopped on a question.

summary.description: What you did, in at most 5 lines.

files_changed.description: Repo-relative paths you created, modified, or deleted.

checks.description: One entry per Verify command in the brief.

evidence.description: The last lines of the command's real output; empty when not_run.

notes.description: Facts the elder should know, each with a path:line.

deviations.description: Where you departed from the brief, and why.

concerns.description: Risks, or disagreements with the brief, that did not block you.

questions.description: Decisions you need from the elder before you can go on.
